oneOf.description: [`v2::InitializeResponse`]; the first request of a connection.

ClientRequest.description: A request the client sends; the comment names the response type.

RequestId.description: A request's id: a string or an integer, as the client chose.

optOutNotificationMethods.description: Notification methods the client does not want.

model.description: `<provider>/<model id>`, or a model id of the server's default provider.

AskForApproval.description: Codex's approval policy; delta's own policy decides, so the server reports `on-request`.

lastTurnId.description: The last turn the fork keeps; the thread's last turn when absent.

oneOf.description: `text_elements` is snake case on the wire, as Codex writes it.
An image by URL (a `data:` URL carries its bytes).

UserInput.description: One part of a user's input.

clearMode.description: Returns to the server's default mode; `mode` wins when both are given.

PermissionsUpdateParams.description: `delta/permissions/update`: removals apply before additions; rules are matched by text.

oneOf.description: Reads inside the working directories run; anything else not allowed by a rule asks.
Also writes inside the working directories run.
Everything runs, except what a deny or ask rule names.

PermissionMode.description: How much a thread's tool calls may do without asking.

PermissionRules.description: Rules in Claude Code's `Tool(specifier)` grammar, by what they decide.

ThreadItem.description: One unit of a turn's work.

PatchChangeKind.description: `move_path` is snake case on the wire, as Codex writes it.

SnapshotNotification.description:
`delta/snapshot`: the thread's whole state, sent when the client fell behind its events.
Items in flight continue with their deltas; anything before is in the snapshot.

ServerRequest.description: A request the server sends; the comment names the response type.

proposedRule.description: The rule `acceptWithRule` would add when the client names none.

ToolRequestApprovalParams.description: `delta/tool/requestApproval`: a call of a tool that is neither a command nor a file change.

SandboxPolicy.description:
Codex's sandbox; delta runs commands in the conversation's environment unconfined, so
the server reports `dangerFullAccess`.

CommandExecutionApprovalDecision.description: Field names of struct variants stay snake case on the wire, as Codex writes them.

mode.description: The mode the thread set; `None`: the server's default.

PermissionRulesResponse.description:
`delta/permissionRules/read` takes no params; the allow rules approvals added for every
thread.

oneOf.description: Accepts and adds an allow rule for every thread.

ToolApprovalDecision.description: The answer to an approval request of any kind.
